acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Slimes family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Blob, T2, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Debris-Roll Soldier (Soldier) archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two fire construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: Knee-high cloudy blob with coins, small bones, a slow drip trail, and no humanoid structure.
Signature mechanic: Debris Roll: coins and bones gather ahead of the core before the knee-high mass surges.
battlefieldDuty: Repeat lane pressure by rolling swallowed debris toward its leading edge.
constructionDimensions: Tier-safe anatomy: T1–T2 have no humanoid structure and carry ember grit around the existing core; T3–T4 preserve their source-supported humanoid crust frame; T5 alone retains its dozen cores across a heat-baffled tide.
Fuel-bearing char crust, smoke vents, pulsing ember seams, and boiled-clear jelly create directional combustion cycles without replacing the viscous body.
counterplay: Cross behind the debris line and hit the core through the newly clear rear wall. Affinity signal: Tier-safe anchors: T1–T2 have no humanoid structure and vent around one core; T3–T4 expose a humanoid crust joint after combustion; T5 exposes one of its dozen cores when heat baffles cycle.
identityInvariants: Rounded, drooping, gravity-obeying jelly with surface-tension edges and a readable internal core remains the family silhouette.
Translucent blue, acid green, amber, or violet is chosen per individual, with suspended debris and a brighter but bounded core.
Viscous flow, drip trails, swallowed objects, crystalline cores, and later crust plates remain spatially coherent.
Internal structure emerges by tier: pseudopod, debris-bearing blob, humanoid crust frame, suspended skeleton, then a multicore tide.
telegraph: Cloudy jelly clears along one edge while coins and bones tumble toward it.
